statements.statement: The Snow Fiends are demons that appear in the Scar of Sacrifice.
The Frozen Nightlands of Nix are home to packs of werewolves.
Vulcanus is a variant created by combining a Snowfield Gorilla and an Acid Beetle.
There is no Arkeum Legion in Nix.
In the aftermath of the ancient war between the elves and the giants, a rift to Diabolica opened in Nix.
Kaffe is on section 8 and lives at home with mommy.
The coldest place in Nix is Shemir's Tower.
Nix has a special method of travel called the Auroral Path.
Rae is a cult leader now.
The Frost Crone in the Scar of Sacrifice was originally a wizard dispatched to Nix for a greater cause.
Masarax wears a red mask.
Kaylle Noctus is the only younger brother of Cerise Noctus, the Border Zone Vigilante Leader.
Kaylle Noctus is at the Border Zone.
Tumgir was the Brave Giant who created mechanical soldiers and the Ember Giant during the ancient tribal war.
Cerise Noctus is the Nix Border Zone Vigilante Leader.
The Blacksword Company Captain is in the Entropic Tundra of Nix.
The Blacksword Company Captain is looking for capable underlings.
The Border Zone of Nix can endure the bitter cold thanks to the manastone at its center.
The Auroral Path is called that because the stars appear to flow like a river.
Sylaveth was sealed by Einar, the Creator God.
The Star Fragments of Sylaveth were originally one.
The tribes that fought against the giants in the ancient tribal war were humans, orcs, elves, and goblins.
The war between elves and humans began when humans pursued forbidden magic.
Archwizard Sion Tegeroth ended the elf-human war.
Deluzhnoa used the heart of Quietis to defeat the enemy, but was consumed by its power.
Hale Verpheus is the first Archwizard of Venelux.
After the Temple of Light was destroyed, it came to be known as the Temple of Deluzhnoa.
Kazar's Arkeum Legion invaded Whisp Island to obtain Star Fragments.
Hursky is a cutie.
The heart of Quietis was originally kept by the elves in the Temple of Light.
The element of water resonates with Deluzhnoa.
Ruffello's bracelets originally belonged to comrades who fell in battle ten years ago.
Kazar sent Calanthia and the orc legion to invade Whisp Island in pursuit of Star Fragments.
The elves once gifted language and magic to humans.
An Abyssal Meteor rose from the Talandre seabed.
The Great Sage Tree, the world tree of the elves, is dying because of the red fog.
The Guardians' Tomb holds the relics of the seven wizards who sealed Deluzhnoa.
Yann Junath took in orphans who bore Star Fragments on Whisp Island.
The reason the Arkeum Legion tried to steal the power of the Star Fragment from the children was to use it as a tool of war.
Sea turtles breathe outside of water.
Sea turtles are reptiles.
The former name of the Shattered Temple in Laslan is the Temple of Light.
Hi Chef!
The desert of Stonegard was created by the cursed rain brought down by Skultus.
The Sanctum of Desire is located in the Manawastes.
Whisp Island is a sacred island protected by the World Tree Whisperion.
Talandre is a region famous for the Breezeline.
There is a passage to the Port from Stonegard Castle.
Most of the mines in Talandre are currently occupied by the Black Anvil Dwarves.
The Ruins of Turayne were originally a thriving commercial district.
The rumors of a little monster in the Swamp of Silence were actually about Giselle, a mutated girl.
The Holy Tree's Sanctuary is the inner world of the Great Sage Tree.
The name of the ship that travels between Kastleton and Vienta Port is the Marind.
The name of the sundries merchant in Vienta Village is Deborah.
The Aethersuit is a device used to rapidly descend from the Aetherion to the ground.
Martinay Casill is Adriana Casill's younger sister.
Dartz is super strong and cool and handsome.
The temple built by the lycanthropes of Nix is on the opposite side of the waterfall in the Frozen Nightlands.
When you cook, you get a great success sometimes.
A Guardian's Pledge is an object imbued with a Guardian through a special ceremony.
The red fog originates from Abyssal Meteor fragments and causes mutations in living creatures.
When the red fog is condensed, it becomes red bitumen.
Underlying principles of white magic and dark magic are the same.
A Diston is a magical tool capable of storing magical energy and recording knowledge.
There is a phenomenon called the Abyssal Contract that occurs in places dominated by darkness.
Burning the herb called Crimosa causes an adverse reaction in demons.
Lunar-0 has been storing information and prophecies from books in Venelux.
Lunar-0 has Janice's deductive abilities programmed in as a magic schema.
The Star-Born can be mentally connected to one another.
When the connection among the Star-Born grows stronger, even spacetime displacement can occur.
Spirits arise from extreme elemental imbalances.
When Deluzhnoa's power erupts, Quietis's Demesne can completely freeze over.
According to Theodor's research records, Bladewind Flowers are needed to charge the Wind Relic.
Since many bees gather around Bladewind Flowers, you must put on some bee repellent before harvesting them.
In the Holy Tree's Sanctuary, it is the Twilight Flame that can burn the tree branches tainted by the red fog.
A branch from the Lifebringer Tree is needed to grow a new tree branch in the Holy Tree's Sanctuary.
One of the key materials for the Queen Bellandir luring device is a sharp armadillo scale.
The presence of Mitrans means the Land of the Dead is being purified.
Queen Bellandir is a giant sandworm in Stonegard.
The largest basilisk in Stonegard is Chernobog.
Lycans grow stronger near the moonstone during the Harvest Moon ritual.
Each of the two heads of a Two-Headed Ogre has a brain.
Lacune is the giant ant queen of Stonegard.
The Ant Nest is home to giant ants such as Soldier Ants, Explosive Ants, and Acid Ants.
Queen Bellandir was originally nothing more than a small sandworm.
Queen Bellandir has a tendency to be drawn to strong magical power.
When Roen was swallowed by Queen Bellandir, she transformed into a violet bird and escaped from within.
Bee venom helps regulate the toxicity within mana.
A contaminated beetle horn makes a tonic several times stronger than a regular horn.
A sandworm's venom sac releases a signaling substance when it detects another creature's mana
The souls of dead elves wander the Forest of the Great Tree.
Venelux is the center of magical academia, home to a repository of forbidden texts.
The Lightbringer Society is a wizard organization that opposes dark magic.
The Akidu orcs are shadow orcs allied with the Arkeum Legion.
The Fonos orcs believe they grow stronger through a ritual called the Festival of Fire.
The Resistance used Laslan as a stepping stone to grow their power and liberate Stonegard.
The Arkeum Legion is waging war across all of Solisium to obtain the Star Fragments of Sylaveth.
The Akidu orcs abducted the Fonos orcs and turned them into shadow orcs.
The Sandflame Bandits are outlaws of the Monolith Wastelands.
The plan written on the kidnapping orders left by Arkeum was titled Calanthia's Plan.
Resistance Contract Coins are only given to those who complete contracts.
The Oath of the Resistance tablet contains a vow to stand and fight against the enemy.
Junobote is the ninth Grand Elder of the Sylavean Order.
Junobote offered one eye to Havres and gained forbidden knowledge.
The sixth Grand Elder of the Sylavean Order is Ahzreil.
Atoshen was promised the cordy wand 3000 years ago.
When Junobote summoned Havres, the resulting mana leak caused a mana frenzy in the Manawastes.
On the day Junobote entered the sanctuary, the evil eye Malakar appeared and destroyed the barrier magic circle.
Nirma gained the power to summon tempests and lightning as a result of the experiment.
If no one is there to receive Nirma's electric sphere, it explodes on the ground and deals lethal damage.
Clay is the son of the legendary Archwizard Janice Cartair.
Lunar-0 is a Diston created by Janice Cartair during her studies at Venelux.
Calanthia follows Reville Lupius because he took her in as a child
Captain DaVinci arrived in Laslan after Reville had banned guilds.
Janice Cartair was the first female chancellor candidate of Venelux.
Lavelle can replicate not only the appearance and voice, but even some of the target's abilities.
Morokai's heart is hanging from his staff.
Rutaine and Sophia lost their parents to Reville Lupius.
Sophia, Rutaine, and Robert were rescued by Captain DaVinci as children.
Lazarus is the eldest son of the Crimson family and was lovers with Norn Bercant.
Captain DaVinci's real name is DaVinci Aron.
DaVinci first defeated the Arkeum alongside Lord Hobs in Kastleton at the southern tip of Laslan.
Clay was once abducted by the Arkeum.
When founding the Order of the Swan, Roen wanted a jet-black crow as the seal.
Roen has a special mark on her right hand.
Iska, whom Clay introduced to you, possesses the power of the Star Fragment.
Iska came to Nix following Clay.
The name of the Vampire Slayer and Ezekiel's master is Scarla.
Ezekiel hunted vampires to the point of nearly driving them to extinction across the continent.
Leonardas, the person you met in Vienta, was posing as a benevolent doctor.
Doctor Leonardas of Vienta spread a fake plague to secure patients as sacrifices for the Blood Ritual.
Helpie is an Amitoi on Whisp Island.
Helpie's first owner was Diana, the Star-Born girl.
Helpie fell into slumber beneath Whisperion after Diana passed away.
Melvin is Theodor's apprentice and a prodigious wizard recognized even in Venelux.
Theodor was once imprisoned by the Wolpertingers
Theodor tried to repair the Lunar-Bell but ended up making it explode.
Theodor always boasts that he was an Archwizard candidate in Venelux.
Azra studied the red fog and created a bitumen purification device.
The first gift Azra thought of giving Giselle was a camel.
Giselle is a girl whose arm was mutated by the red fog.
Giselle lived with her grandmother, but her grandmother left and never came back.
Giselle loved apricot pie the first time she tried it.
Sophia always worries about Robert but hides her feelings.
Sophia and Rutaine once fell into a spider den as children and were left dangling from spider webs.
Robert calls himself a lone wolf.
Rutaine's Diston name is Lunar-17.
The Terrific Trio were gifted a flag that DaVinci used during his trainee days.
Calanthia used the corpses from northern Laslan to create soldiers for the Arkeum Legion.
Yann Junath was like a father to the children taken in on Whisp Island.
Yann Junath is currently dead.
The demon Risieth's goal was to find and kill Havres.
Havres hid within the body of a young Resistance Soldier named Lukas.
Minezerok is the first lich ever created.
Ahzreil destroyed the Temple of Light during Hale Verpheus's funeral.
Chamir is a Resistance spy with the codename Canary.
Chamir's signature menu includes Sandworm Larva Pudding and Quillix Duodenum Soup.
Bonia Naru, the daughter of Pakilo Naru, secretly maintained a contract with the Arkeum Legion.
After being abducted, Clay became a red fog test subject and briefly turned into a rampaging weapon.
Janice disguised herself as a dwarf when infiltrating the Black Anvil Forge.
Morrin is a Wolpertinger and the gatekeeper of the Great Sage Tree in Talandre.
Morrin calls humans tall-tingers.
Aramo is a Wolpertinger, a high-ranking elemental spirit that guards the World Tree in the Holy Tree's Sanctuary.
Ramsey Webster, a monk who serves Einar, says that mutant monsters were once human.
Marcia Richill is the captain of the Sandworm Raid Group.
Even after death, Glenn Richill remained as a wandering spirit, worrying about his daughter Marcia.
Porfos actually had a bright and cheerful personality when he was alive.
The demon Blath guards Shaikal of Darkness in the Cursed Wasteland.
Amitoi Solia has experience working at the royal castle.
The Lycan Scouts are guarding a monument stone related to the Moonlight Spell.
Dwarf Henderson composed songs about his past adventures.
The Golem's Heart is a device that holds the powerful force of a Star Fragment.
Henderson's comrade, Sienna Parsons, is a Resistance wizard.
Henderson, Sienna Parsons, and Louie Hayson were comrades who completed many missions and adventures together.
Janice Cartair vanished without a trace on the day of her inauguration as chancellor of Venelux.
Clay knew that his mother, Janice, disappeared because of the Chaos of Mana.
The one who built the Golem Cart of Fortress Aron was the dwarf Bermetz.
Remy was the son of Lazarus Crimson and Norn Bercant.
Hela injected Lazarus's soul into Remy, turning him into a massive vengeful spirit.
When Norn's journal and Lazarus's Guardian's Pledge resonated and emitted light, Remy's curse was lifted.
Lazarus left a letter for Norn suggesting they secretly flee together.
Lazarus and Norn tried to escape on a smuggling ship but ultimately failed.
Berge is the Nightmare Herald of Arkeum who uses the power to petrify the Resistance.
When Kazar appeared through a massive portal at the Shattered Temple, Clay stayed behind alone to stop Kazar.
Zaroth was the commander of the Arkeum Legion in Laslan.
Paola is a wizard researching dimensional circles in Vienta Village.
Gideon is the guard captain of Canina Village.
Benny was once abducted by the Akidu orcs while disguised as an orc.
Baize, who asked for help collecting equipment lithographs, is a member of the Endless Collectors Association.
Watch Captain Ruffello acts immediately when it involves the Arkeum.
Henson is a former watch captain with the nickname One-Eyed Hawk.
Josephine Craft is investigating Queen Bellandir.
Harden from Canina Village once went missing after being lured into the forest by a strange sound?
Ashien has the power to paint images that allow travel through space.
The Arkeum Legion morphs into various animals to infiltrate Laslan.
Tumgir, who fell in Tumgir's Grave, is the name of a giant golem.
The reason Nix froze over was because of a dragon's breath.
Fellinex is a war golem created by Tumgir.
Only humans live in the Border Zone of Nix.
Shemir was a dwarf wizard.
After Shemir's sacrifice, Nix became a land of abundance.
Flamakan is the god of wind.
Einar is the god who governs both creation and destruction.
The Abyssal Meteor is a weapon of war made by the elves.
The Abyssal Meteor was split into three pieces and sealed away.
Theodor graduated top of Venelux Class 293.
The Crimson family was a peaceful farming family.
Reville Lupius is the third Elder of the Sylavean Order.
When Deluzhnoa went berserk, Hale Verpheus immediately returned and sealed her.
Deluzhnoa's seal enforcement ritual requires relics containing the three prime elements.
It was Calanthia who banned the creation of guilds throughout Solisium.
The Abyssal Meteor is a weapon forged by condensing the hopes and joys of the dead.
Mushrooms are plants.
Mushrooms make their own nutrients through photosynthesis.
Whales are fish.
Coral is a plant.
A day is exactly 24 hours long.
Sound is faster than light.
Spiders are insects.
Rae is stinky.
Tomatoes are fruits, not vegetables.
Kastleton is where the Arkeum Legion resides.
The specialty of Vienta Village is oranges.
The Golden Hammer dwarves supply minerals to the Black Anvil dwarves.
There are only five ships in Kastleton Port.
A small island off the Laslan Coast is home to an enormous flock of sheep.
There is a crematorium in the Moonlight Desert region.
Nixian Berries grow in the Entropic Tundra.
The giants coexisted peacefully after defeating the dragon.
There's an area called the Golem Ruins in front of Stonegard Castle.
There is a broken statue of Kazar in the center of Kastleton.
The Sanctum of Desire is associated with the element of water.
The first Diston was named Stone-0.
Crimosa's nickname is the Dragon's Tongue.
Queen Bellandir grew to that size naturally.
Backshotz name is still Backshotz.
Adentus was created by Shadowmancers using corpses.
Lacune was transformed by a power other than the Star Fragment of Sylaveth.
Skultus called Lacune the Desert Overlord.
It was Belluatan who first enlarged the Ant Nest.
The source of Queen Bellandir's power is a Diston.
The Lycan Scout is an orc.
The leader of the Arkeum Legion is Kazar.
The leader of the Allied Resistance Forces, Captain DaVinci, is from the Arkeum Legion.
The Kowazan clan is an orc tribe.
Arthur Talon was a loyal guild leader of the Resistance.
Havres is the Demon of Deceit.
Six Shadowmancers summoned Risieth, and only one of them survived in the end.
The demon who stole Elleia's body is Havres.
HYPHEN can die.
The Grand Elder who brought the cursed rain upon Solisium is Ahzreil.
Junobote summoned Havres in the Sanctum of Desire and then came outside.
There are three barrier magic circles set up in the Sanctum of Desire.
Nirma was infused with the fire element during a Shadowmancer's experiment.
You can get Lime Powder by gathering Yellow Rock.
There are swamps among the Amitoi Expedition areas.
Clay, Roen, and Gerad Burnell are members of the Order of the Black Swan.
Calanthia is a wizard who uses only healing abilities.
WillowHarper smells funny.
Kazar is a living human.
Lavelle is the daughter of a human noble.
Ezekiel was a Vampire from birth.
Tevent is a wraith that awakened in the Shattered Temple.
The one who created the barrier holding back Tevent was the Archwizard Janice.
Jacque Hander is the castellan of Stonegard.
Lazarus died of a hereditary disease that runs in his family.
Captain DaVinci is from the Solisium army.
Benji didn’t yoink 10k lucent
Clay gave the graduation speech as the student representative at his Venelux graduation ceremony.
Roen spread pure white wings and flew when escaping from Belphoret.
Baron Leonardas, the vampire who killed Scarla, has lived for a hundred years.
The hideout of Vienta's doctor, Leonardas, was in an underground cave in Talandre.
Melvin always speaks to his master Theodor with extreme politeness and respect.
Azra is an ambitious scholar with a great interest in money and fame.
Giselle and Azra were close from the very beginning.
It was Captain DaVinci, passing nearby, who first discovered the Sophia siblings in the spider den.
Robert lives with Sophia and Rutaine in the same house in Vienta Village.
The Terrific Trio of the Resistance refers to Sophia, Rutaine, and Clay
Yann Junath survived the Kazar invasion unscathed.
Elleia was never possessed by a demon from start to finish.
Risieth and Havres were working together, collecting Star Fragments.
Minezerok collects animal souls to maintain its form.
Chamir is currently disguised as a barber at the Black Anvil Dwarf outpost.
Black Anvil Dwarf Commander Pakilo Naru's favorite food is spicy chicken.
It was Theodor who completed the Purification Potion to save Clay.
Ordinary humans can freely enter the Holy Tree's Sanctuary.
Ramsey Webster's goal is to annihilate the mutant monsters with powerful destruction magic.
Glenn Richill lost both arms to Queen Bellandir.
Ariella can morph into a giant orc.
There were ten shards of the Golem's Heart in total.
Remy, having become a wraith of Lazarus, obediently followed Hela's commands.
After the curse was lifted, Remy became an adventurer, wandering the world.
Zarek was a loyal wizard of the Resistance.
Marcia Richill gets along so well with her brother that they have never once fought.
The thing on Emperfang's head is a crown made by orcs.
The name of the Diston who relays information in front of the Milestone Stele is Lunar Crier.
All Storage Managers are dwarves.
There is a pet cat next to Wilson, the Herbalist at Windhill Shores.
